body: The number of equivalence relations on the set {1, 2, 3} is:
solution: Equivalence relations correspond to partitions of the set. {1,2,3} has 5 partitions: 1 with one block, 3 with two blocks, and 1 with three blocks.

body: Two fair coins are tossed. The probability of getting at least one head is:
solution: P(no head) = 1/4, so P(at least one head) = 1 - 1/4 = 3/4.
